Dream 563F by Golden West – Where Everyday Comfort Meets Cottage Charm
If you’ve ever dreamed of a home that feels both modern and timeless — welcome to the Dream 563F, one of the newest display models at The Home Boys in Spokane Valley, WA. Built by Golden West, this 3-bedroom, 2-bath manufactured home blends upscale design with cozy cottage charm, making it perfect for lake lots, view properties, or narrow spaces that demand curb appeal without compromise.
Cottage Porch with Timeless Appeal The Dream 563F greets you with a signature cottage-style porch, complete with composite decking and a refined roofline that sets it apart from traditional porch models. Add columns, shutters, and a 16-foot gable over the living room windows, and you’ve got a manufactured home that looks anything but manufactured. Optional garage configurations make it easy to design around your lot’s layout and lifestyle.
Built for Energy Efficiency Like all Golden West Dream Series models, the 563F can be equipped with a heat pump system—an energy-efficient heating and cooling solution that works hand in hand with your Carrier Smart Furnace. It’s designed for year-round performance, even in the colder Spokane winters. Pair that with Energy Star windows, exterior GFIs, and solar panel readiness, and you’ve got a home built for long-term savings.
Open Living with 9-Foot Ceilings and Natural Light Step inside, and the Dream 563F instantly opens up with a spacious living room under 9-foot coffered ceilings. Five oversized 80-inch windows flood the space with natural light. The floor plan flows seamlessly into the kitchen and dining area, creating a perfect environment for entertaining or everyday family life.
The upgraded Dream Deluxe Package brings elevated touches like crown molding, can lights, and premium trim work that rival site-built homes.
A Kitchen Designed for Real Life The heart of this home is its modern farmhouse kitchen — complete with rustic hickory cabinetry, a large functional island with quartz countertop, and pull-out storage shelves. The farmhouse sink, stainless-steel Samsung appliances, and optional Gourmet Chef package (featuring a 27.8 cu. ft. fridge, dishwasher, and microwave) bring both style and practicality.
The corner coffee bar or buffet station adds charm and flexibility, whether you’re hosting brunch or grabbing a quiet morning cup.
Primary Suite with Spa-Like Bath The primary bedroom feels like a true retreat. It’s large enough for a king-sized bed, offers transom windows for natural light, and comes with an optional ceiling fan and coffered ceiling.
The ensuite bath features double sinks, rustic hickory cabinetry, subway tile backsplash, and an upgraded 60x40 tile shower with double showerheads and glass doors. A linen closet and soaking tub add spa comfort to everyday life.
Flexible Spaces for Work and Family Two additional bedrooms — both with 80-inch windows and ample closets — can easily serve as guest rooms, home offices, or kids’ rooms. A larger utility room solves one of the biggest homeowner complaints by offering space for a freezer, utility sink, and even a stacked washer-dryer setup.
Smart, Comfortable, and Ready for You Every Clayton-built product, including this Golden West Dream home, comes with a Smart EcoBee thermostat, designed to learn your daily habits and optimize comfort while saving energy automatically.
Compare to Similar Models The Dream 563F replaces the popular Spruce model with a more modern, affordable layout while keeping the features customers loved most. It falls between the rustic Metolius (Matus) and the modern Brook Haven, offering a balanced style for those who want a home that’s warm but not overly traditional.
On Display Now You can tour the Dream 563F in person at The Home Boys — Washington’s largest manufactured home dealer — located in Spokane Valley.
